activity_summary: You looked out from the chamber at the orchard wall in the first light. The bench was still in shadow. The paper and the stone showed as a pale corner. You did not go down.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked from the casement and did not go down.

entities.name: the orchard bench
entities.context: Mentioned in First light on the orchard wall

facets.activity: Looked out at the orchard wall
